description: facebook: Post. GET /v1/facebook/post. Get a public Facebook reel or video by URL (/reel/, /watch?v=, /<page>/videos/ and share links). Returns post_id, like_count (all reactions), comment_count, share_count, description, creation_time, the video's SD and HD URLs, author and sound. view_count is included only when the public page shows it; logged-out reel pages usually do not. shared_post_id and shared_post_url are null. Posts that Facebook only shows to  Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

allow_long_transcription.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored. Transcripts are Facebook's own captions, never AI, at no extra cost.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

get_transcript.description: Set get_transcript=true for the reel's own captions (SRT) at no extra cost. Missing captions return transcript: null.

url.description: The URL of the reel or video

name: facebook_post
